ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a large triangle, and a straight line slanting upward to the right passes through the right side of the triangle. At the intersection of this straight line and the right side of the triangle, 110° is labeled on the upper right, and angle 7 is labeled on the upper left in the position near the interior of the triangle. Angle 7 and 110° are adjacent at the same intersection; they share one ray of the right side of the triangle, and the other sides respectively lie along opposite directions of the same straight line. Reasoning: The problem asks to find m∠7. Because ∠7 and 110° form a linear pair, are adjacent, and the outer sides are on the same straight line, the sum of their measures is 180°. Therefore m∠7 = 180° - 110° = 70°.
